Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that handles partial and final streaming recognition events using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 2 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 3 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 4 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 5 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 6 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
import time

def streaming_speech_to_text():
    """
    Performs streaming speech-to-text recognition using Azure AI Speech service.
    Handles partial and final recognition results from the default microphone.
    """
    # Retrieve Azure Speech service subscription key and region from environment variables.
    # These variables must be set for the code to run: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    service_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not service_region:
        raise ValueError(
            "Please set the environment variables AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION "
            "with your Azure Speech service credentials."
        )

    # Configure Azure Speech service
    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    # Set the language for speech recognition (e.g., "en-US" for US English)
    # speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"

    # Configure audio input from the default microphone
    audio_config = speechsdk.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True)

    # Create a speech recognizer instance
    speech_recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

    # Event handler for intermediate recognition results (partial)
    def recognizing_callback(event: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        if event.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizingSpeech:
            print(f"RECOGNIZING: {event.result.text}")
        elif event.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            print("RECOGNIZING: No speech could be recognized.")

    # Event handler for final recognition results
    def recognized_callback(event: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        if event.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            print(f"RECOGNIZED: {event.result.text}")
        elif event.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            print("RECOGNIZED: No speech could be recognized.")

    # Event handler for session cancellation
    def canceled_callback(event: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        print(f"CANCELED: Reason={event.reason}")
        if event.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={event.error_details}")

    # Event handler for session stopped
    def session_stopped_callback(event: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        print("Session stopped event.")
        # Ensure the recognizer is stopped if the session naturally ends
        speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition_async()

    # Connect the event handlers to the speech recognizer
    speech_recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_callback)
    speech_recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_callback)
    speech_recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_callback)
    speech_recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_callback)

    print("Starting continuous speech recognition. Speak into your microphone.")
    print("Press Enter to stop recognition.")

    # Start continuous recognition asynchronously
    # This method returns a future, but we don't need to await it immediately
    # as the recognition runs in the background.
    speech_recognizer.start_continuous_recognition_async()

    # Keep the main thread alive to allow background recognition to run
    # and to wait for user input to stop the process.
    input() 

    print("Stopping recognition...")
    # Stop continuous recognition and wait for the operation to complete
    speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition_async().get()
    print("Recognition stopped.")
